'''Table Rock''' was part of the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course know as [[Sebulba's Legacy/Legends|Sebulba's Legacy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. The rock formation split the main road into two distinct parts, a twisting higher path on the left and a lower straight path on the right.
